title: calamintha parviflora subsp. glandulosa
intro: Calamintha parviflora subsp. glandulosa, commonly known as Mountain mint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Mountain mint include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate pain. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
